slug: 2026-06-23 Africa's Data Centre Boom Where The New Facilities Are Being Built

facts.fact: TechTrends Africa reports Rack Centre's 12 MW LGS2 carrier- and cloud-neutral facility in Ikeja, Lagos, has been completed, giving 13.5 MW across Rack Centre's two Lagos sites; the article gives no completion date, so as_of is its published date 2026-06-23.

TechTrends Africa reports MTN Nigeria launched phase I of its Dabengwa Sifiso Data Centre in Ikeja in July 2025 (4.5 MW, 780 racks) together with a local cloud service billed in naira for Nigerian businesses and government entities.

TechTrends Africa says phase I of MTN Nigeria's Dabengwa Sifiso Data Centre, in service since July 2025, was built to Tier III standards; no Uptime Institute certification or TIA-942 rating is named, so this is the article's statement of design standard.
